title_en: Stories of Modern China (2/20): Old Li the Blacksmith
note_en: 越A越B means "the more A, the more B," and with a single verb it shows something steadily increasing: 机器越做越好 "the machines got better and better," 名单越写越长 "the list kept getting longer and longer." Don't confuse it with 又A又B, "both A and B at once," as in 铁器又便宜又好看 "the ironware was both cheap and good-looking."
